Writes the playbooks and checklists teams actually adopt, runs training for account managers and new starters, and turns how good people work into something others can use. cover_letter: I am applying for the Sales Enablement Lead role at OakNorth. You want someone who can watch how good people sell and distil it into something others can use. For 5 years I have supported the sales and account teams of Global Blue, part of Shift4, and I have been promoted three times in four years.

I wrote the client onboarding playbook and country checklists that two global account teams adopted as standard and extended to new markets such as Peru. I run regular training and briefings for account managers, country teams and new starters, and I got account managers onto new Salesforce reporting by fixing their problems one by one. I hold a First-class degree in Communication & Media, and clear writing is the part of the job I enjoy most.

I come from payments rather than lending, so I would start by learning from your dealmakers before telling them anything. I built 50+ commercial pricing models across 40 brands, so I am comfortable with commercial detail.
I would welcome the chance to discuss the role.

answers.Why OakNorth?: Enablement is the part of my work I most want to grow, and OakNorth's dealmakers are the kind of team where good enablement shows.
